notes.title: Major Deckbuilder overhaul - The new patch is now live! 🔥
notes.content:
[h1]Revolutionists! 🔥[/h1]

We've been all ears since Liberte was released. Your feedback has been our guiding light, and we've made some pretty big changes based on what you told us. Here are a couple of words on changes, improvements, and bug fixes. 🔥

[h2]New Deckbuilder[/h2]
One of the most notable transformations is the complete redesign of the deckbuilder. It's now more intuitive and easily readable at a glance. We hope this design will encourage you to play around with your deck a bit more! Instead of multiple UI windows, everything - building your deck, crafting cards, and unlocking new blueprints - is now all in one place. Additionally, we added suggestions on what amount of a particular type of card is best placed in a deck so that it is effective and fun to play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/713ed75607ebab0701e7fb15a13961cac36d12d9.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Level Selection Screen[/h2]
We've added a map feature that gives you all the information you need at a glance. Starting a run is simpler now - no need to vote, just pick a quest from the map. You'll also get extra details like the quest's objective, the faction it's for, and the curses you might encounter.

That's right! We've also changed how curses work. Instead of gathering them as you progress, you'll get new ones each time you start a new level. 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/c8e08f35ad27da6888a2349badabe28a0c536049.jpg[/img]

[h2]Besides that, Patch 1.0.3 also includes:[/h2]
⚔️ A chance to encounter a powerful Mini-Boss enemy at mid-level;
☠️ Bliss Curses change with each level in a run;
🔎 Ability to preview Bliss Curses before entering a level;
🤒 The final boss fight can now be played on higher difficulties!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/7ee9687ffdf0ebebe829c161a7a442ecefbda69d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Some of the bugs that we fixed:[/h2]
🐛 multiple instances of holes in geometry causing players to get stuck;
🐛 multiple typos in conversations;
🐛 stutters in Victor's combat animation;
🐛 other minor bug fixes.

Join our discord, and remember to leave a review here on Steam if you haven't already! It really helps a lot!

[url=https://discord.gg/kUaGqc6fjd][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/d9be87df2cb245267bde06bcd88c94b04771463c.jpg[/img][/url]

Until next time!
SuperStatic Team

notes.title: Powerful cards during the runs, New Patch coming next week | Post Launch Support
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

The first week following the debut of [b]Liberté[/b] is behind us, and we gotta say that the support from our community overjoys us. Thanks for the reviews (the good and the bad ones, too!) [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1590160/reviews/]Steam Reviews[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1590160/discussions/]Discussion Page[/url]. We've had some great feedback from many friends out there on YouTube, and we can't wait to hear/watch/see all the new takes on our precious indie gem. Here are examples that we loved:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N577gioTPKc&ab_channel=Haelian&ab_channel=Haelian

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a8cMGcnhTRA&ab_channel=Splattercatgaming

Now, you're probably wondering what's next, huh?

The Superstatic team is working diligently to carry out the current development plan as we move forward, concentrating on bug fixes and resolving any issues that popped up since the launch. While the primary focus is on resolving graphic bugs and minor gameplay issues, we also look into the general feedback regarding overall game pacing and card mechanics. So, the upcoming patch will be live next week, but if you're willing to be a part of our QA team, join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/j7TNVxruSH]Discord server[/url][/b], where you can find private-beta credentials and test new fixes with us [b]starting this weekend[/b]. It's fun, we promise!

[url=https://discord.gg/kUaGqc6fjd][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/d9be87df2cb245267bde06bcd88c94b04771463c.jpg[/img][/url] 

In addition to bug fixing, we are also working on new content and features to expand the world of Liberté further. More details are coming soon, so stay tuned for more information and another completed change log.

[h2][b]Buy powerful cards during the run
[/b][/h2]

Fasten your seatbelts and get ready for the news. 

Do you remember Flea, Tribe's secret agent and one of the playable characters? Now, you'll be able to meet her during the runs in the[b] Flea's Market[/b]. Flea moves in with her stall! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/6b437970965e17b3880f52f7a6777cba8f059eb8.png[/img]

As a dear ally to both Ori and Eli, Flea has established herself as one of the most "prominent" thieves in the city. Her mastery in the art of finding and moving valuables allowed her to build the market she runs, but things aren't easy for anyone in the city. Hence, she's back with her little shop.

With the new update, [b]Flea will have powerful cards for sale (Their quality will be equal to [b]Keepsakes[/b], which are the strongest cards you craft as the game progresses). They will give you additional boost and variation to improve your deck during runs.[/b] A word of advice - make sure to keep some extra money in your pocket, because Flea's a tough negotiator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/4afec822dbe1ed2f5cc437f744a24bf7bedf81f3.png[/img]

We also turned your requests regarding UI into action. [b]From now on, you will see the card instantly after interacting with the shop. [/b] At the end of the day, you want to know what you're buying, right?

[h2][b]Many thanks once again![/b][/h2]

Throughout the whole development process, we always wanted to stay in touch with our community. Opting for Early Access was an opportunity to shape Liberté into a game that's fun to play & fun to create. Needless to say, all of the recommendations, tips, and comments were simply essential. Time and time again, you've proven to be a great community to work with.

Also, it's big that our game gets compared to the blockbusters such as Hades or V-Rising. When we started the project, we didn't even expect anyone to make such comparisons. It's incredibly flattering because those are two awesome games. 

However, it's a huge responsibility too, which is not easy to carry when you have two people working currently on the development side - our studio is far smaller in scale, and on top of that - this is our first indie project. We hope to keep on keeping on (yes, we did play a bit of Death Stranding), so we're doing our best, with the limited work capacity at hand. So, what we're trying to say is that things might take longer to develop, and we ask for your patience and understanding, and support that carries us further. At the end of the day, Liberté means proof that even a tiny team like ours can make an indie rogue-lite that's fun to play!

Follow us on Social Media and join Discord to get all the latest news!
🔹 [url=https://www.facebook.com/LiberteGame]Facebook[/url]
🔹 [url=https://twitter.com/LiberteGame]Twitter[/url]


Until next time,  
SuperStatic Team

P.S. Let's show some love to our composer Filip Kaźmierczak, whose awesome soundtrack has been a key addition to the Parisian ambient of Liberté!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2356830/Libert__Digital_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Goodbye, Early Access! Welcome Liberte 1.0 🔥
notes.content:
[h1]Dearest Revolutionists! [/h1]

As you know, Liberte will have a Full Launch in just three days, on [b]May 23[/b].
What's changed during Liberte's development process?

We've regularly polished the game for over a year since it entered the Early Access stage. Our team has been busy introducing tons of content improvements and, of course, bug fixes. As a result, we now have:
🔥 new bosses, 
🔥 improved mechanics, 
🔥 UX and UI tweaks, 
🔥 better game pacing, 
🔥 enhanced enemy and environment behavior, 
🔥 a greater emphasis on intuitive deck-building based on player feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/29ae2d56972f64e6df47bff93ce72baa7d0ef35e.gif[/img]

During Early Access, decision-making and the story itself gained many improvements. We emphasized [b]real decisions in roguelike runs[/b], and going through all available paths will now allow you nearly [b]40 hours of gameplay[/b].

We also [b]redesigned deck-building[/b], so you'll be able to prepare builds for various fighting styles and characters. Additionally, we introduced [b]a new playable character[/b], Flea, that combines two fighting styles and brings a spear into the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/29cc04fd81058c863101e7decbee326d8f5239c5.png[/img]
While casting [b]voice actors[/b], we focused on bringing the characters to life, giving them personality, making the Parisian world vibrant, and giving decisions more significance.

We also entrusted our soundtrack to a wonderful and talented composer, [b]Filip Kazimierczak[/b]. The music was inspired by various sources, such as classic sci-fi movies like "Alien," as well as film scores by Trent Reznor, Atticus Ross, Daniel Pemberton, Ben Salisbury, Geoff Barrow, and Michael Abels. You'll also hear the inspiration driven by revolutionary songs from the French Revolution era somewhere in the background. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/1e047601e779a8ea46cee5d39372c5efc2d05ec7.png[/img]
As a result, we got an[b] atmospheric and evocative soundtrack[/b] that perfectly complements the game's story and environment. It's genuinely fantastic, and we're happy to let you know that the digital version of the soundtrack will also be available for purchase on the day of Liberte's release 🎶

To sum it all up, a lot has changed during Liberte's Early Access - from gameplay and quality-of-life improvements, through endless bug fixing, to practically a new life in the form of expanded content, voiceovers, and a brand new soundtrack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/95ee329396b0bb90cf3964d60990f031b299f1c1.png[/img]
In the meantime, there's [b]a series of videos [/b]showcasing the gameplay and mechanics of Liberte. We're releasing a new video every day until May 23! Here's the latest one, in case you've missed it:

[previewyoutube=LIGA8J6H5iQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you to those who have been following us tirelessly all this time ❤️
And if you're not following us on social media - it's never too late! 😉
Join us on:
🔹 [url=https://www.facebook.com/LiberteGame]Facebook[/url]
🔹 [url=https://twitter.com/LiberteGame]Twitter[/url]

Until next time!
SuperStatic Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/f08c763c45b217093698fb88f33f24145be4a217.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/911e15ef7b300675cc66ba2b120e0a252fc4540c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Flea’s background:[/h2]

The story of Flea inspires many kids in The Tribe. With almost nothing by her side from a very young age, Flea worked hard to open a small stand with antiquities in decent prizes. Knowing the craft paid off, and Flea was a smart kid who knew that relying on the law and authorities would never work out.

Flea climbed the ladder by jostling around, meeting the most influential people in Paris, and selling them exquisite pieces of furniture shipped from faraway lands.

At some point, she started helping her people out and opened Flea Market, where poorer Parisians could sell products and services of all sorts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/996f20b2052f67b589a134588eca1a96907b7e70.jpg[/img]

Being part of the Tribe, Flea also needed to learn how to protect herself. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/b3d4585c5e15b6de8f62d8aa44e953ba848dd2cb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/850c2828da7055a2df6e5c97c6f0034f3f048914.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Plans for Early Access - Content Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Following up on our information concerning the development plans, we decided to shed some light on what we have cooking. Thanks to your involvement, we created a schedule for the next couple of months. As promised, we’re back with plans for the development of [b]Liberté[/b].

[url=https://discord.gg/j7TNVxruSH][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/d9be87df2cb245267bde06bcd88c94b04771463c.jpg[/img][/url]

Since there’s still time in December, we will also release a [b]minor patch[/b] with a new playable character and a batch of new cards. The [b]new playable character[/b] will be Santa’s surprise, though. Maybe you can guess which faction we are thinking about…

We’re also adding some minor bug fixes and an [b]improved deck tutorial[/b]. We’ll share the detailed info soon.

[b]Now, let’s move on with the Roadmap![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/ad81694f4947c6681076aa0c69e3b813e5126e7a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Patch 0.14: Liberté story is complete! [/h2]

We’re pushing ourselves to complete the Story content of the game and, if possible, lock the dialogues and texts so they can be translated next month. This means a LOT of writing and tying loose ends.
Yep, #fingerscrossed!

Kajetan, our number one writer on this one, has even created a map with every single story point leading to another - this occupied half of the floor in his apartment. Maybe one day, we will share the image! The final game will see [b]more than 160 encounters with all the characters[/b]. With a few tweaks to the storytelling mechanisms, the flow of the narrative will be more dynamic and throw you right in the middle of the events unraveling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/74544915c46049046e03c2c4ff78ac4dac6a36b4.png[/img]

[h2]Patch 0.15: - Lady Bliss final battle & localisation [/h2]

For those, who will see it through to the end of the revolution, we’re preparing something special. 
On second thought, special is probably only one of the words we could use to describe it. It’s also going to be:

[i]Mind-blowing?[/i] Probably.
[i]Bizarre?[/i] For sure.
[i]Cosmic-horror-body-horror-terrifying?[/i] Hell yeah!
[i]Muddy?[/i] Wait, what…

Liberté finale will see all of the characters pushed against the wall, in the most turning point since the appearance of Lady Bliss in Paris. Needless to say, [b]you[/b] guys[b] will have the final saying in how the story ends [/b]- and it’s going to be one tough choice to make. 

Aside from that, the translation itself is still an ongoing process – [b]our plan is to collect requests concerning localisations and build a list of languages we should be bringing to you, step by step.[/b] Since the decision has not yet been made, you can also help move the needle: [b]If you want to help out, Wishlist our game or join our discord[/b]. Each Wishlist includes information on the language (based on location), which adds this valuable information. Also, we will be sending out a survey soon!

[img][/img]

[h2]Patch 0.16: Final patch before the release[/h2]

Tick, tock, tick, tock… Time’s getting closer to the release!
[b]Patch 0.16 will be the final patch before the full version arrives.[/b] It’s mainly focused on minor game improvements and bug fixes. If you have any suggestions regarding the gameplay or new features, [b]let us know [/b]now, so we can evaluate them and prepare a task list to implement the most valid ones in this very patch.

[h2]Release Date[/h2]

This is also the first time we’re talking about the release window. We’re aiming for a [b]Q2/Q3 Full Release[/b], but as you know – based on your feedback and our production plan, this is the perfect spot to fulfill our promises and push Liberte out from Early Access, finalizing the 1.0 version.

That doesn’t mean we’re going to stop there! We have a long list of features we’d like to implement in the game, but right now, we need to focus on delivering the above roadmap. As usual, we thank you for playing, supporting us, and providing feedback. 

We’re keen to hear from you, too - share your thoughts about the plans and tell us which update gets you hyped!

notes.title: Announcement: Focus on story & gameplay polishing in December & January
notes.content:
[b]Bonjour Mesdames et Messieurs. We have a message for all of you who braved the streets of Paris since Liberté entered Early Access.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/7882b599b51f989bc9c7b7ed9e7fa780f3c70e34.jpg[/img]

[b]As you know, we're very close with our community and always try to understand and meet your needs. [/b]That’s why we have decided to open the gates of Early Access and invite many of you to the community-driven development process to have a direct approach to task management in line with people's needs. 

For a team of five, meeting your expectations takes a lot of time and work. [b]Most of our actions and improvements to the game come from your feedback, and we are glad to say that this input is much appreciated and primarily valuable.[/b]

Now, we would like to shed some light on where our focus is and what changes we are introducing.

[b]Note: [/b][i]We have updated this announcement to better portray the changes we are introducing. TL:DR, our focus until the official premiere is on polishing the game and expanding the narrative. The online co-op development is put on hold until the release; we plan to focus on it after the 1.0 version. There are no changes to the local co-op. As usual, we will be working with our community to polish the game.[/i]

[h1]Focus on the story: more dynamic narrative, new dialogues, lore collectibles[/h1]

One of the key areas that we plan to develop in these final moments before leaving Early Access is to expand and polish the storytelling aspect of Liberté. Our writer - Kajetan - is planning to expand all the arcs and deliver a great finale for you to experience. We are planning to release the planned roadmap in a matter of days, but here's a sneak peek:

[list]
[*] A more dynamic narrative. Due to some big changes in the way the narrative works, we are able to have scenes starring more characters, add more linear events, and open gates to side stories.
[*] Expanded lore. The next patch updates will bring a lot of new content, including lore-related collectibles.
[*] Hundreds of new dialogues. That's right. We are adding lots of new stuff, with the plot finally revealing the truth behind Lady Bliss and what's the endgame for the revolution.
[/list]

We honestly can't wait to see it live!

[h1]Online Co-op update: further development on hold until the release of version 1.0 & available on another Steam branch [/h1]

We curiously observed different statistics on where Liberté brings the most fun. Data showed us not only your preferences gameplay-wise but also what parts of the games are most appreciated and which require some polishing (how do you like the new dodge, btw?). So,[b] only 6% of all revolutionists tried our online co-op feature[/b]. While we appreciate the interest, we see many difficulties in providing constant support for that mode. [b]Multiplayer bugs are twice as difficult to reproduce and way harder to fix without sacrificing our performance toward expanding Liberté's content and ensuring the road to the final release goes smoothly.[/b]

As a result, [b]we have decided to put the development of the online co-op until the release of the 1.0 version[/b]. 

Let's make it clear that we're not abandoning this idea of online co-op. [b]Our solution is to leave the online function in a separate build, allowing players to switch to a different branch in the Steam properties[/b]. That way, if you want, you can still have fun with online co-op. This change will go live the day we ship the patch planned for January. We wanted to give you a heads-up so that the change won't happen overnight.

[b]We want to put our efforts into something significantly more important, which will impact the game's final state.[/b] Our dream is to make Liberté one of the best roguelite games, and we believe it will happen with your support.

[b]Our early plans for getting back to this idea are somewhere between Patch 1.1 and 1.2 after the final release. [/b]Leaving Early Access is on the horizon, and depending on how the launch goes and how many people will ask for this particular mode, we plan to revisit the idea of developing the online co-op further.

[h1]As always, you're the fire to our revolution[/h1]

On a final note, [b]we are humbled and overwhelmed by your positive vibes[/b], whether on the Discord channel, Steam Review, and Community Center or offline events like Gamescom or PAX West. [b]No sugar coating here - your support fuels the creation of every line of code, dialogue, and asset.[/b] We want to thank you for your continuous support and for helping us make Liberté a cool game!

Talk to you soon!
[b]SuperStatic Studio
Daniel & Kajetan[/b]

[b]We’ve added new areas and redesigned streets for a more cluttered, lively city feel.[/b] The 18th century Paris was a busy, noisy city, with trader’s booths and markets scattered around the city. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/b5a9c560630fca493b1249259d74f086f0ddbd12.gif[/img]

A special shout-out to those who felt the urge to kick barrels, benches, and all kinds of supplies too! We’ve added the feature of [b]destructible objects[/b]. And we recommend testing it out because who knows what you may find inside…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/aad21c753dcf63781d50a743036bd389cce8fd94.gif[/img]

[b]Rene also got a new, improved dodge[/b]. Many of you mentioned that the mechanic could be smoother, and that’s what we aimed to improve. Let us know how it works for you now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/44b65b8e3b1168b9c115a306b47f057de423b065.gif[/img]

Aside from new arrivals, we’ve decided to continue [b]expanding keepsakes and cards[/b]. 

And to make things even more worthwhile, we added [b]more rewards to each Faction’s Reward Track[/b]. Keep on Rebelling, Tribing, Churching, and Crowning, and claim your rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/527fb43bcda406d36a64a937193d9dbfea45c405.jpg[/img]

And finally, for those who seek real challenges, there’s a [b]new Bliss Curse[/b] to overcome – Curse of the Gambler!

Full changelog below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/107e8c9f335575c8c5129fdcb62d2eb0b1cdc633.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Added three brand new areas you can encounter in the City.
[*] Added over 30 new, destructible props
[*] Redesigned streets for a more cluttered, lively city feel
[*] Added eight new Keepsakes to unlock.
[*] Added ten new levels to each Faction's Reward Track
[*] New Bliss Curse - Curse of the Gambler
[*] Added new performance settings.
[/list]
[h1][b]Changes and Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Visuals: Improved look of almost every unique location in the game with new props and style fixes.
[*] Controls: When the 'Attack at Cursor' option is turned off, attacks will now track movement input instead of the closest enemy.
[*] Controls: With multiple enemies clumped up together, Player attacks will now target one closest to the cursor.
[*] Controls: The player can now change movement direction during a dodge.
[*] Controls: Default Dodge direction with no input has been changed to forward instead of backward.
[*] Controls: Increased Player's running speed with an unsheathed weapon by 15%
[*] Animations: Improved Player animation fluidity when dodging or quickly changing movement direction.

[*] Cards: The game will now ask if you want to play a Card that will replace your skill.
[*] Cards: Dying Blood card mana cost increased from 3 to 5.
[*] Cards: Coagulation now restores 5 Armor with each hit.
[*] Cards: Some more powerful Cursed Blood skills now cost 20 Health to activate.

[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where some controllers would be unresponsive if turned on before the game launch.
[*] Controls: The player attack will no longer pause if it starts in the middle of a transition from walk to run
[*] Controls: Fixed player losing attack streak when very rapidly clicking the mouse to attack.
[*] Poison DOT hits will no longer be countered by skills that allow attacks to miss.

[*] Player Two can now again interact with the Shapeshifter's Repertoire
[*] Fixed a bug where the Player could burn all cards in the tutorial and get stuck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/efa13e8699f59831e96292707fbe1ab4416e319b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Content Update #6 - Conquer Paris as Ana or Viktor, collect precious keepsakes!
notes.content:
👋 Hey Everyone! 

This update is BIG – apart from bringing in [b]TWO fan-favorite characters[/b], we're introducing some new in-game mechanics to extend the gameplay further and randomize each playthrough. Details below! 

[h2][b]Added two new playable characters - Ana and Viktor[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/30ada22c60f1a538f32d19a6c5d941ce551f7318.png[/img]

Ana and Viktor are joining the pool of characters you can control. Each of them comes with [b]unique cards and a playstyle[/b]. If you like a more direct approach, you'll appreciate Viktor's Axe with a hidden surprise for those who don't know when to run. Ana is entirely different – she's in love with any kind of weapons, just waiting to put a bullet or a blade into anyone who interferes on her journey. To better portray what we're talking about, look at these GIF, which show the difference in basic attack combo between all the characters.

[url=https://thumbs.gfycat.com/IllustriousEvergreenBoar-size_restricted.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/ff2786556de5e09eefe28074155351fcbfcfd278.gif[/img][/url]

Just a tiny detail - due to your pact with Bliss, Rene can morph his image into someone he knows very well. This is why you're not exactly playing as Ana or Victor, and thanks to that, he can get closer to all faction leaders and understand their point of view, and create relationship with them. 

[h2][b]Added Daily Quest system – Favors[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/947c7a5af8345c4033ae12b40a4339d0b6a84b25.jpg[/img]

Favors are daily quests for each of the in-game factions. These can vary from day to day, but the rewards behind them are worth the time. 

[b]Added Faction Influence Levels and their rewards[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/d3eeb0959cde955138da6bafa04aeb472efad082.png[/img]

Doing Favors will [b]increase the number of your Influence Levels[/b] and help you unlock [b]Faction Rewards[/b]. Influence level in other words is how the game will change with if one of the faction will be dominating. With each level you'll receive a reward like in-game currency, materials or unique cards o your deck.

[h2][b]Added New, Unique type of Cards – Keepsakes[/b][/h2]

Every character has it's special item, these items allow Rene to transform into them and use their abilities, we call them [b]Keepsakes[/b], and these make a difference... Those are unique cards that strongly change the game's basic mechanics [e.g., affect how cooldown works]. They also change the balance of decks and some builds, further increasing the Liberte's [b]replayability[/b]. 

There can be three cards of this type in a deck. To start with, we have prepared [b]12 different Keepsakes[/b], but this number will undoubtedly change in the future. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/adcd80edda85cd44e0eb91ff0bc34f7dce1738ca.png[/img]

That pretty much sums up today's update. Thank you for your patience and constant feedback. We appreciate your opinions and suggestions via Steam Community comments or over Discord. Join us there and leave feedback about the game and the newest update! 

Have a great day!

notes.title: Content Update #5 - The Endless Bliss
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Happy to share the news of our new content patch going live! We've been focusing on overhauling Bliss rules and design, and adding a brand new, exciting game mode!
🤫  PS. That one aggravating curse has been removed from the game. Yep, you know which one 😉




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/31c994a6b32240c704b869b461d45a7d210a3599.jpg[/img]
[h2]🌺 New Bliss[/h2]
We've redesigned the Bliss to better reflect the chaotic and flowery nature of Lady Bliss. Her overgrown gardens are filled with unique dangers. There are new areas to explore, new enemy combinations, and new demonic Bliss Cards to win. 







[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/d5b59e8e3835dbaf7ef413f2a0a7a914af990f37.jpg[/img]
[h2]🔮 Endless Bliss Game Mode[/h2]
In this new game mode, you can experience the full power of your carefully crafted Deck. You start from character level 20, with infinite mana, and all cards from your Deck already in your inventory. An option to autoplay cards is available to get you quickly into the fray. 

You will need this power to tackle difficult challenges inside the Endless Bliss. In each Endless level, you have 5 minutes to kill the Shade that resides within and its minions. 

If you succeed, you unlock a higher difficulty level. There is no limit to how far you can go - hence, the "endless" part. There are leaderboards to show off to the world that your deck and skills are the true pride of Lady Bliss.

In the following updates, the Endless Bliss will become the primary place to find Card upgrade materials.

notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
We're super proud to let you know about the release of your 4th Content Update. Dig right into new story pieces that explore the relationship between our protagonist and his demonic companion. We're also adding new HQ to rest between missions and new gameplay mechanics. Read on below!

notes.title: Content Update #3 - New Mission, New Cards, New Enemies and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/fd3fea8844d831678b34e937b92801ef0b7e819f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Welcome to our Content Update #3! [/h1]
This month, we've got a lot of new, interesting stuff for you to try. New mission (our best yet!), new enemies to tackle, new cards to collect. Lets dig in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/e44dfad2002444d114a00bb85bf4a1ade0aa4354.jpg[/img]

[h1]Brand New Features[/h1]

[b]New Mission - The People's Court[/b]
We're super proud of this brand new mission. You'll be able to side with the Crown or the Tribe to restore justice to the chaos-stricken City. Climb the Parisian rooftops, visit the village of Montmarte and assemble a Court to put enemies of the People on trial. 

[b]New Enemy in The Tribe - The Bird Catcher.[/b]
This new mysterious Tribe member uses his trusty winged companions to confuse his enemies. Watch out, those birds have sharp beaks!

[b]New Enemy in The Crown - Agent of the Crown.[/b]
Elite agents of the Crown have joined the fray to turn the tide of the revolution to his majesty's side. They use surprise attacks with their sharp rapiers to score a hit before their enemies even know they're coming. When things go south, their smoke bomb gadgets allow them to escape without getting hit.

[b]Added 4 new Quest reward cards[/b]
Depending on whom you'll side with in this brand-new mission, you'll get a chance to get one of 4 new reward cards that augment your fighting abilities. 





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312711/6b287544592b620ad9603fb4a8cae0b921aa8626.jpg[/img]

[h1]Changes and Improvements[/h1]

[b]Mission Intro dialogues are now optional and can be started by talking with characters on the bridge.[/b]
We made this little change to make the game flow faster for expert players, and to give some extra context to those who want to deep into the story.

[b]In singleplayer, you can now quit the game mid-run and resume it later, from the start of your current mission.[/b]
With the run duration growing quickly with each update, this was a must have! When playing offline games, you'll now be able to quit mid-game and return to the same mission after you come back. 

[b]Instead of spawning more soldiers, Crown Officer's flare will now summon a mortar strike.[/b]
Battles with Crown Officers were getting a little too overcrowded. Instead of summoning endless reinforcements, they now have an ability to use artillery to bring their enemies into submission. 

[b]Melee skills will now grant Player brief stagger resistance when used.[/b]
A little buff for our melee Players - melee skills will now give you a short period of invincibility when used. No more interrupts! 

[b]Newly found blueprints cards will now show as a golden drop during game.[/b]
Before, new card blueprints were awarded based on your mission progress only after returning to the Theater. Now, they will appear as gold drops during missions, so you know instantly when you've gotten a shiny reward! 

[b]Player can now hold up to 30 Cards in his inventory.[/b]
Need to keep some cards for late game? No problem. Inventory size has been expanded to 30 slots.

[b]La Voisin will now walk towards the Player when casting Missile Swarm.[/b]
This little buff has been suggested by Kris from our community. La Voisin will now be more formidable to fight and ducking behind a fence will no longer save you from trouble!

[b]Improved Quest Tracker Compass to be more consistent.[/b]
Quest tracker is now snappier and points to objectives more consistently. No more confusion!


[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
We've got some of these too. Thank you to all who submitted bug reports on Steam or our Discord!
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could make Player become unable to turn around and attack.
[*] Fixed a bug where Player would sometimes turn the wrong direction standing high up and attacking.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing black holes to appear in the ground.
[*] Some enemy Skills will again be properly limited by their level.
[*] Soldiers gained during Lamballe mission will no longer go with you to next acts.
[*] Fixed visual glitches in Crafting UI
[*] Fixed endless water appearing under the map for clients in online play.
